title: The Human Chair
synopsis: Ziwen continues reading the mysterious letter from an anonymous sender, who starts to reveal his true purpose.

fullText.simplified:
第二天一大早，我爬进椅子里，等着客户来搬椅子。不多久，他们就来了。在他们搬我这张椅子的时候，有个工人突然说：“这椅子怎么那么重啊！”我在椅子里听到这句话，吓了一大跳。还好，这椅子本身就很大、很重，所以他们也只是说说，没有想到别的地方去。不一会儿，我感觉到卡车开动了。几个小时后，这把椅子被放在了宾馆里。
    刚开始，我还以为我的椅子被放在了宾馆的其中一个客房里。后来我才知道，那个房间不是客房，而是一个让客人看报、说话的休息室。
    文文，看到这里，您应该早就想到我这么做的目的了吧？是的，我就是想在没有人的时候，从椅子里出来，在宾馆里转转，然后找个机会偷东西。有谁能想到椅子里会藏着人呢？我可以像隐形人一样，进出每一个房间偷东西。只要我在客人发现之前爬回椅子中，就没有人可以找到我了。
    我的这个想法可能因为没人想到，所以特别成功。到了宾馆后的第二天，我就偷到了很多东西。听着人们“他跑到那边去了”，“他去哪儿了”的叫声，我感到特别的开心。
    不过，现在我不想和你说这些偷东西的事情，因为我发现了比偷东西更让我快乐的事情。这才是我给您写这封信的真正目的。
    关于这件事情，还要从我的椅子被放在宾馆的休息室时说起。
    椅子送到后，宾馆的老板们都一一过来试坐。但之后房间就变得很安静，听不到一点儿声音。我想房间里应该没有人了吧。但是我刚到这里，就从椅子里出来，我害怕被人发现，所以不敢出来。我坐在椅子里面一动不动地听着外面的声音。
    过了一会儿，我听到了脚步声和一个男人的说话声。他应该是在打电话，说的是英语，我听不懂。脚步声和说话声越来越近了，我正紧张时，一个像是美国人的高大的身子已经重重地坐了下来。隔着椅子的皮革，他坐在我的腿上，就好像我抱着他一样。然后，他好像点了一根烟。在椅子里，我闻到了烟草的味道。
    文文，你能想得到那是一种多么奇怪的感觉吗？因为我太紧张了，黑暗中的我全身发冷，脑袋一片空白。我只是坐在椅子里面，一动也不敢动。
    从那个男人坐下来开始，那一天有各种各样的人在我腿上坐下、起来，但是没有一个人发现我在椅子里。
fullText.traditional:
第二天一大早，我爬進椅子裡，等著客戶來搬椅子。不多久，他們就來了。在他們搬我這張椅子的時候，有個工人突然說：“這椅子怎麼那麼重啊！”我在椅子裡聽到這句話，嚇了一大跳。還好，這椅子本身就很大、很重，所以他們也只是說說，沒有想到別的地方去。不一會兒，我感覺到卡車開動了。幾個小時後，這把椅子被放在了賓館裡。
    剛開始，我還以為我的椅子被放在了賓館的其中一個客房裡。後來我才知道，那個房間不是客房，而是一個讓客人看報、說話的休息室。
    文文，看到這裡，您應該早就想到我這麼做的目的了吧？是的，我就是想在沒有人的時候，從椅子裡出來，在賓館裡轉轉，然後找個機會偷東西。有誰能想到椅子裡會藏著人呢？我可以像隱形人一樣，進出每一個房間偷東西。只要我在客人發現之前爬回椅子中，就沒有人可以找到我了。
    我的這個想法可能因為沒人想到，所以特別成功。到了賓館後的第二天，我就偷到了很多東西。聽著人們“他跑到那邊去了”，“他去哪兒了”的叫聲，我感到特別的開心。
    不過，現在我不想和你說這些偷東西的事情，因為我發現了比偷東西更讓我快樂的事情。這才是我給您寫這封信的真正目的。
    關於這件事情，還要從我的椅子被放在賓館的休息室時說起。
    椅子送到後，賓館的老闆們都一一過來試坐。但之後房間就變得很安靜，聽不到一點兒聲音。我想房間裡應該沒有人了吧。但是我剛到這裡，就從椅子裡出來，我害怕被人發現，所以不敢出來。我坐在椅子裡面一動不動地聽著外面的聲音。
    過了一會兒，我聽到了腳步聲和一個男人的說話聲。他應該是在打電話，說的是英語，我聽不懂。腳步聲和說話聲越來越近了，我正緊張時，一個像是美國人的高大的身子已經重重地坐了下來。隔著椅子的皮革，他坐在我的腿上，就好像我抱著他一樣。然後，他好像點了一根煙。在椅子裡，我聞到了煙草的味道。
    文文，你能想得到那是一種多麼奇怪的感覺嗎？因為我太緊張了，黑暗中的我全身發冷，腦袋一片空白。我只是坐在椅子裡面，一動也不敢動。
    從那個男人坐下來開始，那一天有各種各樣的人在我腿上坐下、起來，但是沒有一個人發現我在椅子裡。

sentences.english: Wenwen, can you imagine what a strange feeling that was?

sentences.traditional: 因為我太緊張了，黑暗中的我全身發冷，腦袋一片空白。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ tài jǐn zhāng le hēi àn zhōng de wǒ quán shēn fā lěng nǎo dài yí piàn kòng bái
sentences.english: Because I was so nervous, in the darkness I felt chills all over the body and my mind had gone blank.

sentences.simplified: 我只是坐在椅子里面，一动也不敢动。
sentences.traditional: 我只是坐在椅子裡面，一動也不敢動。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì zuò zài yǐ zi lǐ miàn yí dòng yě bù gǎn dòng
sentences.english: I just sat inside the chair and didn’t dare to make a single movement.

sentences.simplified: 从那个男人坐下来开始，那一天有各种各样的人在我腿上坐下、起来，
sentences.traditional: 從那個男人坐下來開始，那一天有各種各樣的人在我腿上坐下、起來，
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà ge nán rén zuò xia lai kāi shǐ nà yì tiān yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de rén zài wǒ tuǐ shang zuò xia qǐ lai
sentences.english: Starting from that man sitting down, all sorts of people sat on my legs and got up again that day.

sentences.simplified: 但是没有一个人发现我在椅子里。
sentences.traditional: 但是沒有一個人發現我在椅子裡。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì méi yǒu yí ge rén fā xiàn wǒ zài yǐ zi lǐ
sentences.english: However, not a single one discovered I was inside the chair.

sentence_translations: At dawn the next day, I crawled into the chair and waited for the customer to come and pick up the chairs.
Before long, they arrived.
When they were lifting the chair that I was in, one worker suddenly said:
“This chair is so heavy!” I heard this from inside the chair and was very frightened.
Fortunately, the chair itself was very big and heavy.
So they were just talking and didn’t think anymore of it.
Before long, I felt the truck begin to move.
After a few hours, this chair was placed inside the hotel.
In the beginning, I thought that my chair had been placed inside one of the guest rooms in the hotel.
Only later did I find out that the room was not a guest room.
It was a lounge for customers to read newspapers and talk.
Wenwen, now that you have read so far, you have probably already thought of my purpose for doing this.
That’s right, I wanted to come out of the chair when nobody was around and wander around the hotel.
Then I would look for an opportunity to steal something.
Who could imagine that there would be a person hidden inside a chair?
I could be like an invisible man, going into every room to steal things.
As long as I crawled back into the chair before the guests discovered, then no one would be able to find me.
Perhaps because no one had thought of my idea, it was particularly successful.
I stole many items on the second day after arriving at the hotel.
I felt very happy when I heard people calling out “Where did he run off to?” “Where did he go?”
But, right now I don’t want to talk to you about stealing things, ..
.. since I discovered something that made me even happier than stealing.
This is the real reason why I am writing this letter to you.
Regarding this affair, I must start from when my chair was placed in the hotel lounge.
After the chair was delivered, the hotel managers came over and took turns sitting on it.
But after that, the room became very quiet, and not a single sound could be heard.
I figured that there probably weren’t any people in the room.
But, I had only recently arrived here.
I was afraid that if I came out of the chair someone would find me. So I didn’t dare to come out.
I sat inside the chair and listened, without making a single movement, to the sounds outside.
After a while, I heard footsteps and the voice of a man.
He was probably making a phone call. He spoke in English, which I could not understand.
The sound of footsteps and voices grew closer.
I was feeling nervous, and then someone who seemed to be a tall American sat down heavily on top of me.
He sat on my legs separated by the leather of the chair, like I was embracing him.
And then, he seemed to light a cigarette.
I could smell the tobacco from inside the chair.
Wenwen, can you imagine what a strange feeling that was?
Because I was so nervous, in the darkness I felt chills all over the body and my mind had gone blank.
I just sat inside the chair and didn’t dare to make a single movement.
Starting from that man sitting down, all sorts of people sat on my legs and got up again that day.
However, not a single one discovered I was inside the chair.
